# PDF library

`pdf-lib.cjs` is the unmodified standalone distribution of pdf-lib 1.17.1.
Source: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib/tree/v1.17.1

The distribution includes code from pdf-lib, @pdf-lib/standard-fonts, @pdf-lib/upng, pako and tslib. Their notices are included beside this file. This folder contains third-party PDF code, not handwriting weights or samples.
